description: Defines the OA_Admin_UI_Component_Form class extending HTML_QuickForm, managing form elements, validation rules, decorators, and client-side validation integration for the Revive Adserver admin UI.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Component_Form
classes.description: A PHP class extending HTML_QuickForm to manage form creation, validation, decorators, and client-side validation for the admin UI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form, registers custom elements, validation rules, and decorators, and sets default attributes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and regenerates CSRF token if validation fails.

methods.name: registerJQueryRuleAdaptor
methods.description: Registers a new jQuery validation rule adaptor.

methods.name: forceClientValidation
methods.description: Enables or disables default client validation for rules.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Overrides parent method to add validation rules, considering client validation settings.

methods.name: addGroupRule
methods.description: Adds validation rules to a group of elements, considering client validation.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the form.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a group of elements to the form.

methods.name: addDecorator
methods.description: Adds a decorator to a specific form element.

methods.name: getDecorators
methods.description: Retrieves decorators for a specific element.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the form to an array representation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the form to an array.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationMethods
methods.description: Generates jQuery validation methods script based on active rules.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationRules
methods.description: Generates jQuery validation rules script based on active rules.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationBuilder
methods.description: Returns the builder object for jQuery validation scripts.

methods.name: getActiveRules
methods.description: Retrieves active validation rules for the form elements.

methods.name: hasRequiredFields
methods.description: Indicates if the form has required fields.
